issues.concern: The English translation misrepresents the Japanese meaning. '溜息が出るほどだった' means 'it was enough to make me sigh' or 'it made me sigh in admiration', not 'it was breathtaking'. While 'breathtaking' can be a result of admiration, it doesn't directly convey the 'sigh' aspect of the Japanese.
issues.suggestion: The scenery was so beautiful that it made me sigh in admiration.
